_comment: Where the launcher's record of the instance names a file that CurseForge no longer has (or that the pack must not use), the pack names this one instead. tools/build-curseforge-pack.py applies these over the record; tools/check-curseforge-ids.py finds the ones that are gone. Remove a pin when the launcher's record has caught up.

pins.name: Just Enough Resources
pins.why: The instance had 1.6.0.17 (file 6506298), whose CurseForge page is gone (404 on 2026-10-21). 1.6.0.12 is the newest 1.21.1 NeoForge file CurseForge lists. It needs JEI 16 or later; the pack has 19.
